conflict: Canonical defines exactly 5 modules; a 6th modules/finance module exists.
impact: Breaks Law 13 (fixed 5 modules); unauthorized actor surface /finance/*.
recommendation: Remove modules/finance; move cash_management endpoints under admin module.

conflict: Payments is a provider-only concern in canonical docs, but domains/payments/ exists as a full domain.
impact: Violates Law 12 (fixed 15 domains); duplicates payment logic already in domains/finance/services/payments/.
recommendation: Remove domains/payments/; keep payment orchestration in domains/finance/services/payments/ and SDK adapters in providers/payments/.

source_b: backend/domains/media/ (directory with models, schemas, services, events.py, features.py, ports.py, subscribers.py)
conflict: Canonical states media has no dedicated domain, yet domains/media/ is structured as a full domain package.
impact: Violates Law 12 (fixed 15 domains); blurs Postgres-schema vs domain boundary.
recommendation: Either add media as 16th canonical domain or demote domains/media/ to a schema-level package outside domains/.

conflict: Five provider packages exist that are not in the canonical provider tree.
impact: Violates Law 9/16; undocumented providers may bypass circuit-breaker/retry conventions.
recommendation: Document the five providers in ARCHITECTURE_STACK.md or remove if unused.

conflict: FastAPI canonical 0.141.x vs locked 0.115.2 (25+ minor versions behind).
impact: Missing features, security fixes, and behavioral changes from 26+ releases.
recommendation: Bump FastAPI to 0.141.x or update TECHNOLOGY_STACK.md to match installed version.

conflict: Uvicorn canonical floor 0.35.0+ vs locked 0.51.0 (newer but range undocumented).
impact: Behavior drift in HTTP/WebSocket handling; may invalidate middleware assumptions.
recommendation: Pin Uvicorn in TECHNOLOGY_STACK.md to installed version or validate 0.51.0 against middleware contract.

conflict: Alembic canonical 1.19.1+ vs locked 1.18.5 (one minor version below floor).
impact: May lack migration autogenerate fixes needed by 77-migration codebase.
recommendation: Bump Alembic to 1.19.1+.

conflict: pydantic-settings canonical 2.9.1+ vs locked 2.7.1 (two minor versions below floor).
impact: May lack env-prefix fixes relied on by config.py SettingsConfigDict.
recommendation: Bump pydantic-settings to 2.9.1+.

conflict: prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator canonical 8.1.0+ vs locked 7.1.0 (one major version below floor).
impact: Missing metrics buckets or FastAPI compatibility patches required by observability stack.
recommendation: Bump to 8.1.0+ or update TECHNOLOGY_STACK.md.

conflict: sentry-sdk canonical [fastapi] 2.68.1 vs locked 2.66.1 without [fastapi] extra.
impact: May lack FastAPI-specific integration (request-id breadcrumbs, route error handling).
recommendation: Install sentry-sdk[fastapi]==2.68.1.

conflict: stripe canonical 15.5.1 vs locked 15.3.1 (two patch versions behind).
impact: May miss payment-method or webhook signature fixes required by payment orchestration layer.
recommendation: Bump stripe to 15.5.1.

conflict: python-magic is forbidden; puremagic 2.2.0 is canonical. requirements.txt locks python-magic==0.4.27 and omits puremagic.
impact: Introduces libmagic CVE surface; violates approved MIME-type detection stack.
recommendation: Replace python-magic==0.4.27 with puremagic==2.2.0 in requirements.txt.

conflict: psycopg/psycopg2 are forbidden in production code; requirements.txt locks psycopg2-binary==2.9.12.
impact: Adds forbidden driver to image; violates asyncpg-only database policy.
recommendation: Remove psycopg2-binary==2.9.12 from requirements.txt.

conflict: pytz and tzlocal are forbidden; requirements.txt locks pytz==2026.3.post1 and tzlocal==5.4.4.
impact: Violates zoneinfo-stdlib policy; adds unnecessary dependencies that may shadow stdlib behavior.
recommendation: Remove pytz and tzlocal from requirements.txt.

conflict: requests is forbidden; requirements.txt locks requests==2.34.2.
impact: Pulls forbidden sync HTTP client into image; risk of blocking event loop if imported in async code.
recommendation: Remove requests==2.34.2 from requirements.txt.

conflict: Canonical rate limiter is fastapi-limiter-valkey (imported in production), but requirements.txt declares slowapi/limits and omits fastapi-limiter-valkey.
impact: Builds may fail to install the rate-limiter; ImportError at startup when Valkey is available.
recommendation: Replace slowapi==0.1.10 and limits==5.8.0 with fastapi-limiter-valkey in requirements.txt.

conflict: Canonical Uvicorn dependencies uvloop 0.21.0 and httptools 0.7.0 are absent from requirements.txt.
impact: Uvicorn may fall back to stdlib asyncio and pure-Python HTTP parsing, losing documented 2-4x throughput benefit.
recommendation: Add uvloop==0.21.0 and httptools==0.7.0 to requirements.txt.

conflict: Canonical circuit-breaker pybreaker 1.4.1 is absent from requirements.txt.
impact: Provider calls lack documented circuit-breaker wrapper; cascade failures unguarded.
recommendation: Add pybreaker==1.4.1 to requirements.txt.

conflict: DEFAULT_COUNTRY canonical default US vs code default AE.
impact: RLS session context, localization, and tax rules default to wrong country for non-UAE deployments.
recommendation: Align config.py default to US or update TECHNOLOGY_STACK.md to reflect AE market focus.

conflict: Law 19 forbids float for money; vat_rate and zozi_commission_rate are typed as float in typed settings.
impact: Rounding errors in VAT and commission calculations; financial discrepancies in orders and payouts.
recommendation: Change vat_rate and zozi_commission_rate to Decimal in config.py and _FLOAT_KEYS.

conflict: Next.js canonical 16.3.5 vs web_app 16.3.4.
impact: May miss SSR/ISR fixes or build-tooling patches affecting App Router.
recommendation: Bump Next.js to 16.3.5.

conflict: framer-motion canonical 13.2.0+ vs web_app ^12.0.0.
impact: Missing animation features, gesture improvements, and potential RSC compatibility fixes.
recommendation: Bump framer-motion to 13.2.0+ in web_app.

conflict: Zustand canonical 5.0.14 vs web_app ^5.0.11.
impact: May lack middleware or persist fixes present in 5.0.14.
recommendation: Align web_app Zustand to 5.0.14.

conflict: Zod canonical 4.3.6 vs web_app ^3.25.76 (major version gap).
impact: Different validation semantics, error shapes, and type inference; forms and API payloads may fail validation unexpectedly.
recommendation: Upgrade web_app Zod to 4.3.6 or update TECHNOLOGY_STACK.md to Zod 3.x.

conflict: @hookform/resolvers canonical 5.2.2 vs web_app ^5.9.1.
impact: Zod 4 integration may require resolvers 5.2.x; 5.9.x may have breaking resolver-API changes.
recommendation: Pin @hookform/resolvers to 5.2.2 or validate 5.9.x against Zod 4 migration.

conflict: Expo SDK canonical 57.0.20+ vs mobile_app ~57.0.9.
impact: Missing OTA updates, EAS build fixes, and native module patches.
recommendation: Bump Expo SDK to 57.0.20+.

conflict: React Native canonical 0.86.3 vs mobile_app 0.81.4.
impact: Missing New Architecture features, performance patches, and native module fixes.
recommendation: Bump React Native to 0.86.3 or update TECHNOLOGY_STACK.md.

conflict: React canonical 19.2.8 vs mobile_app 19.1.0.
impact: Missing RSC and concurrent feature fixes; may cause hydration mismatches with shared code.
recommendation: Bump mobile React to 19.2.8.

conflict: Next.js rewrites expose standalone /hr/* prefix, but no canonical hr module exists; hr domain is accessed through employee module (/api/v1/employee/hr/*).
impact: Frontend navigation to /hr/* will 404 or proxy to non-existent backend route.
recommendation: Remove /hr/:path* rewrite and replace with /employee/hr/:path* or remove standalone hr route group from frontend.

conflict: Canonical Python 3.13.x vs dev Dockerfile FROM python:3.11-slim.
impact: Local dev environment runs different Python minor version than prod; async behavior and dependency resolution may diverge.
recommendation: Update backend/Dockerfile base image to python:3.13-slim.

conflict: Canonical Postgres 16 for dev vs docker-compose.yml uses postgres:18-alpine.
impact: Local dev DB may have schema defaults or planner behavior differences from documented target.
recommendation: Change docker-compose.yml db service to postgres:16-alpine.

conflict: Canonical mandates pnpm exclusively; root package.json scripts invoke npm run directly.
impact: Monorepo workspace resolution may break; shared package symlinks may not be created.
recommendation: Replace root package.json scripts with pnpm equivalents or remove root orchestrator in favor of pnpm workspace scripts.

conflict: Two sibling directories exist for the logistics-partner module group, violating the one-route-tree-per-actor rule.
impact: Duplicate route groups cause ambiguous navigation, SEO duplicate-content risk, and potential route shadowing.
recommendation: Delete or merge the duplicate logistics-partners directory into logistics-partner.

conflict: Both hr.py (file) and hr/ (package directory) exist in modules/employee/routers/. Python resolves import to the package, shadowing the .py file.
impact: The hr.py file is unreachable; code expecting the module file will import the package instead, causing attribute errors.
recommendation: Remove the orphaned hr.py file; consolidate all HR router code into the hr/ package.

conflict: SQLAlchemy canonical 2.0.52 vs locked 2.0.51 (one patch version behind).
impact: May lack ORM query-planning or async-session fixes.
recommendation: Bump SQLAlchemy to 2.0.52.

conflict: fastapi-limiter-valkey is imported in production (rate_limiter.py:24) but absent from requirements.txt.
impact: Docker builds and pip install -r requirements.txt will not install the rate-limiter, causing ImportError at startup.
recommendation: Add fastapi-limiter-valkey to requirements.txt.

conflict: Canonical production command uses Gunicorn with Uvicorn workers; dev Dockerfile runs Uvicorn directly without Gunicorn.
impact: Dev container may not mirror production process management; Gunicorn graceful-restart and pre-fork behavior absent locally.
recommendation: Add Gunicorn-based dev CMD or document intentional Uvicorn-only dev mode.
